articles.headline: Mom of Cape Verde's Vozinha gets visa to attend next World Cup match
articles.description: The mother of Cape Verde star goalkeeper Vozinha has been granted a visa to enter the United States in time for her 40-year-old son's next World Cup match, House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries said Wednesday.
